title: Reduce site theme to a light yellow palette

requirements.text: Update the site-wide Tailwind OKLCH theme tokens to use a light/pale yellow palette (less saturated and less intense than the current hard yellow) across the entire app (public portal + Agent Arena), by adjusting the CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css for background/foreground/card/popover/primary/secondary/muted/accent/border/input/ring (and corresponding *-foreground tokens).

quotes: its too much colour now change to lite yellow

acceptanceCriteria: The global background and surfaces (background/card/popover) render as a light/pale yellow rather than a strong saturated yellow.
Primary/secondary/accent colors are visibly softer (reduced color intensity) while maintaining clear hierarchy between surfaces and interactive elements (e.g., buttons/links).
Text remains readable with sufficient contrast against the light yellow backgrounds (foreground and *-foreground tokens are set appropriately).
The updated palette applies consistently in both default and dark mode (no reversion to the previous hard yellow values).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only and must be composed, not edited).
Keep changes scoped to visual styling (no functional changes to listings, agent flows, or backend logic).
nonGoals: Adding new features or changing application routes/behavior.
Introducing new authentication or data storage changes.
Creating or editing image assets as part of this color adjustment.
